summary.en-US: Pin your favourite YouTube channels to a thin bar at the top of YouTube.

description.en-US:
Keep the channels you watch most one click away. Features
  • Pin a channel from its channel page, a video or a Short with the Pin button
  • Drag pins to reorder them
  • Hover a pin and click × to unpin
  • Pins sync across your devices with Firefox Sync
No data is collected. The extension only talks to YouTube itself.
